summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the rich repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode to include Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the title sequence format (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, guarded by is_terminal like show_cursor. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once per control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and Black formatting are unverified. Nothing was committed.
